persons.name: Jīvanasiṃha
persons.evidence: liṣitam pāṭana cyāsala tola cikaṃvahīla vaṣnyā vāḍā vaida jīvanasiṃha

persons.as_written: śrī mahārāja raṇauddīpa siṃha rāṇā bahādura
persons.name: Raṇauddīpasiṃha Rāṇā
persons.evidence: śrī mahārāja raṇauddīpa siṃha rāṇā bahādurakā kalakaṭṭā savārī huṃdā pāuṣārī jādā bhāvaprakāśako kitāp 10 rupaiñā kaṃpanīle kīni malāi vakasa bhayo

relations.evidence: śrī mahārāja raṇauddīpa siṃha rāṇā bahādurakā

notes: The scribe Jīvana Siṃha notes in Nepali that during Prime Minister Raṇauddīpa Siṃha's journey to Calcutta in 1932 VS, a copy of the Bhāvaprakāśa was bought for 10 Company rupees and gifted to him, which he then transcribed onto Nepali paper in 1935 VS.
